2363-4659-5224-7692.description:
Cast Hangarback Walker by paying {1} due to Shuri, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Hangarback Walker.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Hangarback Walker, adding {C}{C}.
When Hangarback Walker dies, Together Forever triggers, returning Hangarback Walker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

728-2459-5006-8170.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Rograkh is starting in your graveyard.
728-2459-5006-8170.description:
Cast Rograkh by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Rograkh spell. Then, activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Rograkh, putting a +1/+1 counter on Grimgrin and untapping it
Repeat.

2023-4518-6006-7060.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kor Skyfisher and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

3899-5254-6627.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
3899-5254-6627.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the creature with power 4 or greater.
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Army creature token if you don't control one, then putting four +1/+1 counters on an Army you control.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability, putting a charge counter on Spawning Pit
Repeat.

1329-1778-2178-3899.notablePrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
1329-1778-2178-3899.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Memnite from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Memnite from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Memnite.
When Memnite dies, Emry triggers, untapping Emry.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

1170-3375-5131-8095--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-3375-5131-8095--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to The Immortal Sun.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hammerhead
Repeat.

2111-3967-6792.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Wingrattle Scarecrow
When Wingrattle Scarecrow dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Wingrattle Scarecrow enters, Mm'menon triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Wingrattle Scarecrow
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

2034-3263-6970-7850.description:
Cast Abby from the command zone by paying {3} plus commander tax if applicable.
Abby triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Fungus Zombie creature tokens named Cordyceps Infected equal to the amount of mana spent to cast it.
When Abby enters under an opponent's control, Mirror of Life Trapping triggers, exiling Abby.
Choose to return Abby from exile to the command zone.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Cordyceps Infected token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat step 5 until you have enough mana to cast Abby.
Repeat from step 1.

1558-3147-3875-4231-7810.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1558-3147-3875-4231-7810.description:
Play Azorius Chancery.
When Azorius Chancery enters, it and Tireless Provisioner trigger
Resolve the Azorius Chancery trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Tippy-Toe.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

443-1263-2511-4871.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Magus of the Bridge trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1619-4050-4605-5542-6147.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-4050-4605-5542-6147.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Rilsa Rael from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Rilsa Rael enters, it and Preston trigger twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Rilsa Rael.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Rilsa Rael that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Rilsa Rael token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Rilsa Rael token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Rilsa Rael that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the first Rilsa Rael trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-4050-4605-5542-6147.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

1008-1619-4605-5542-6797.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1008-1619-4605-5542-6797.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Undermountain Adventurer from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Undermountain Adventurer enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Undermountain Adventurer.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Undermountain Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Undermountain Adventurer token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Undermountain Adventurer token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Undermountain Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the Undermountain Adventurer trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1008-1619-4605-5542-6797.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

439-5256-5659-5929.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Arashin Sovereign.
When Arashin Sovereign dies, it triggers, putting itself from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill cards equal to Arashin Sovereign's power, which will cause you to mill Arashin Sovereign.
As Arashin Sovereign is a Lhurgoyf due to Leyline of Transformation, Disa's first ability triggers, returning Arashin Sovereign from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

586-3967-5258-5618-7646.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Yahenni ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

1768-5686--5.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, Juniper Order Ranger triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and Juniper Order Ranger.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat

206-6575-6684.description:
Activate Terra, Magical Adept by paying {4}{R}{G} and tapping it, exiling it and returning it to the battlefield as Esper Terra.
When Esper Terra enters the battlefield, its first chapter ability triggers, creating a token copy of The First Tyrannic War and then putting two lore counters on it.
The First Tyrannic War token's first, second and third chapter abilities trigger.
Resolve the first trigger. Then, resolve the second trigger, putting a lore counter on Esper Terra.
Esper Terra's second chapter ability triggers, creating a token copy of a nonlegendary enchantment you control.
Resolve the third First Tyrannic War trigger, putting two lore counters on Esper Terra and causing you to sacrifice the First Tyrannic War token.
Esper Terra's third and fourth chapter abilities trigger. Resolve the third ability's trigger, creating a token copy of a nonlegendary enchantment you control.
Resolve the fourth trigger, causing you to add {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}, and then exile Esper Terra and return it to the battlefield as Terra, Magical Adept.
When Terra, Magical Adept enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to mill five cards and return up to one enchantment card from among them from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1765-4050-6888.description:
Cast Traveling Plague by paying {3}{B}{B}, attaching it to another creature you control.
When Traveling Plague enters, Chishiro triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature Traveling Plague is attached to.
When the creature dies, Traveling Plague triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the token created in step 2.
When Traveling Plague enters, Chishiro triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat from step 3.

2653-2893-4136-6664.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it on the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
When the basic land enters, Nissa and Roaring Earth trigger.
Resolve the Nissa trigger, adding {G}.
Resolve the Roaring Earth trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1268-5457.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four creatures with different powers.
1268-5457.description:
Activate Selvala by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Crab Umbra by paying {2}{U}, untapping Selvala.
Repeat.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Avatar Kuruk

1409-6913-7009.manaNeeded: {1}{U} plus {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn
1409-6913-7009.description:
Activate Chameleon using Avatar Kuruk's ability by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Chameleon by paying {1}{U}, blinking it. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Avatar Kuruk.
When Chameleon enters, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability triggers, repairing it and Chameleon.
Repeat each turn.

2034-5003-5223-6773.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another nontoken creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers. Choose not to pay.
Activate Xu-Ifit by tapping it, returning a creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Xu-Ifit, adding {C}{C}.
When Xu-Ifit dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return it from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.

224-907-3314-3430-6763.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand that can be cast using three in any combination of {G} and/or {W}, and have the mana to cast it.
224-907-3314-3430-6763.description:
Cast the creature in your hand by paying its mana cost.
Chulane triggers, causing you to draw a card and put Selesnya Sanctuary from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Holding priority, activate Selesnya Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}{W}{W}{W} due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger, returning it from your hand to the battlefield.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Chulane.
Resolve the creature spell cast in step 1.
Activate Chulane by paying {3} and tapping it, returning the creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2557-4321-5777-6451.description:
Activate Camellia by paying {2} and sacrificing a Food.
Camellia's first ability triggers, creating two Foods and two 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
Resolve the Camellia ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on each other Squirrel you control.
Activate the two Foods by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat.

1263-2018-4871-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Luminous Broodmoth and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Luminous Broodmoth trigger, returning Bloodsoaked Champion from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia abilities from steps 1 and 5, causing target player to mill cards equal to twice Bloodsoaked Champion's power.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

232-2232-5778.description:
Cast Priest of Urabrask by paying {2}{R}, plus an additional {2} for its offspring cost.
When Priest of Urabrask enters the battlefield, it triggers twice and Cloudstone Curio triggers once.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning nothing to your hand.
Resolve the first Priest of Urabrask trigger, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Resolve the second Priest of Urabrask trigger, creating a token copy of it that is 1/1.
When the Priest of Urabrask token enters the battlefield, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning the nontoken Priest of Urabrask from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Priest of Urabrask token's trigger, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

914-3719-5256.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least four artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-3719-5256.description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least four Treasure tokens.
Activate three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{B}.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist.
Activate Ruthless Technomancer by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing a Treasure token, returning Dockside Extortionist from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

575-3565-4050.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one blue card in hand.
575-3565-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Dragon's Eye Savants, adding one mana of any color.
When Dragon's Eye Savants dies, Yedora triggers, returning Dragon's Eye Savants to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Activate Dragon's Eye Savants by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Dragon's Eye Savants's morph ability by revealing a blue card from your hand, turning it face up.
Repeat.

813-914-1235.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least six artifacts and/or enchantments.
813-914-1235.description:
Cast Twinflame by paying {3}{R}{R}, creating a token copy of Dockside Extortionist and Scholar of the Ages with haste.
The tokens enter the battlefield, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Dockside Extortionist trigger, creating at least six Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Scholar of the Ages trigger, returning Twinflame from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate five Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{R}{R}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you can also return another instant/sorcery using Scholar of the Ages, and cast it infinite times.

1945-2232-3273-5012.description:
Pay {R} to activate Planebound Accomplice putting Chandra, Flamecaller onto the battlefield.
Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Chandra, Novice Pyromancer to your hand.
+1 Chandra, Flamecaller creating 2 elemental tokens with haste.
Then pay {R} to activate Planebound Accomplice once again, putting Chandra, Novice Pyromancer onto the battlefield.
Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Chandra, Flamecaller to your hand.
-1 Chandra adding {R}{R}.
Repeat.

1358-3525-4306.notablePrerequisites:
Nyx Lotus does not have summoning sickness.
You have more than three devotions of blue color.
1358-3525-4306.description:
Activate Sydri by paying {U}, causing Nyx Lotus to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Cast Pemmin's Aura by paying {1}{U}{U}, enchanting Nyx Lotus.
Activate Nyx Lotus by tapping it, adding mana of that color equal to your devotion of that color.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Nyx Lotus.
Repeat from step 2.
